title: Local sessions are as autonomous as cloud sessions
ruling: Owner 20:28 CST Nov 13, relayed by the consultant (chat; triage did not see it), after learning that cloud sessions get three merge allows from merge/cloud_allow.json that local ones do not (session-tiers line 123): local should have been as autonomous as the cloud. Every allow, autoMode entry and setting that cloud sessions get, local sessions get too, on Mac and Windows. The role-file and merge-role-proof guards still bound who merges. Rewrites session-tiers line 123.
quote: im never there on the computer either, local should have always been as autonomous as the cloud .. no wonder on local i get asked to create sessions and not in the cloud
